summary: Gladstone Capital Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement and a supplemental indenture for a $60M registered direct offering of 7.000% Notes due 2029. The notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with existing unsecured debt, and were issued under an effective shelf registration. Proceeds will repay credit facility borrowings, fund new investments, and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf, not a special situation transaction like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No premium, board recommendation, or change-of-control mechanics apply, and the deal is straightforward debt capital raising.
